recall_philosophy.summary: 宽进严标、导读优先：不要因新作尚未沉淀或看起来不够突破而激进过滤；贴题近期新作尽量收录，通过 1-2 句白话导读 + 透明工程标签让读者一眼判断值不值得深读。

reading_tiers.deep: 核心高价值论文（Tier 1 核心主线高贴题、真实在线评测、开源环境/代码/数据、在线 RL/Verifier、或高热老作/获奖作）：重点细写方法机制、实验条件与横向定位。
reading_tiers.scan: 新作追踪条目（高召回覆盖，不漏潜力股）：保持完整结构化字段，重点把导读、与现有做法的核心差异和客观标签写清晰，方便读者 5 秒速扫自筛。

topics.name: Computer Use
topics.focus: 可执行的桌面、网页、移动或跨应用任务；工具使用、OS/Shell/GUI 混合操作、长程规划、失误恢复、轨迹合成和实际任务成功率。
arxiv_queries: "computer use" AND agent
"computer-use" AND (agent OR benchmark OR OSWorld)
("desktop agent" OR "OS agent") AND (execution OR trajectory OR planning)
"cross-application" AND agent AND (desktop OR mobile OR web)
hard_exclusions: 与真实计算环境执行无关的纯文本对话或纯知识问答

topics.name: 多模态编程
topics.focus: Code→Video、Code→Image、Image→Code、Video→Code、3D Code 五个子方向每天都查，允许真实可执行代码参与的其他跨模态方向（如 SVG/Manim/HTML/Shader/CAD/Blender 脚本生成与反推）。
arxiv_queries: ("image to code" OR "screenshot to code" OR "UI to code" OR "chart to code")
("code to video" OR "programmatic video" OR "Manim" OR "scene program") AND video
("SVG generation" OR "TikZ" OR "HTML generation" OR "code to image") AND (code OR program)
("3D code" OR "CAD code" OR "Blender" OR "procedural 3D") AND (LLM OR VLM OR code)
hard_exclusions: 无可执行代码参与的普通文生图（T2I）、文生视频（T2V）或纯神经 3D 生成

topics.name: GUI Agent
topics.focus: UI 感知、grounding、状态验证、动作决策；重点关注真实交互、在线 RL、reward/verifier 设计、rollout 架构、多端迁移（Web/Mobile/Desktop）以及有明确条件说明的评测。
arxiv_queries: "GUI agent" OR "GUI grounding" OR "mobile agent"
"web agent" AND (RL OR "reinforcement learning" OR grounding OR trajectory)
("UI grounding" OR "screen grounding" OR "click prediction") AND (VLM OR agent)
("GUI" OR "web agent") AND (rollout OR verifier OR reward)
hard_exclusions: 与界面交互无关的纯自然图像目标检测或通用视觉定位

topics.name: 环境规模化
topics.focus: 可扩展的 Agent 环境合成、模拟器或 mock apps/websites、自动任务与验证器（verifier）生成、可复位状态、容器/沙盒调度与在线训练高吞吐基础设施。
arxiv_queries: ("environment synthesis" OR "synthetic environment" OR "mock app" OR "sandbox") AND agent
("task generation" OR "verifier generation" OR "verifiable environment") AND (agent OR RL)
("Gym" OR "RL environment") AND (GUI OR web OR mobile OR software) AND (scaling OR scalable)
("containerized" OR "resettable" OR "rollout throughput") AND agent AND environment
hard_exclusions: 仅限传统低维 MuJoCo/Atari 且无环境合成或 Agent 系统泛化意义的常规 RL 控制论文

topics.name: 递归自我改进
topics.focus: 迭代改善策略、技能、工具、代码或 Agent 系统本身；关注持出集迁移、多轮自我改进退化/坍缩分析，明确区分更新上下文/记忆、技能库、代码还是模型权重。
arxiv_queries: ("self-improving" OR "self-improvement" OR "recursive self-improvement") AND (agent OR LLM)
("self-evolving" OR "skill evolution" OR "automated agent design") AND (agent OR LLM)
("self-play" OR "self-taught" OR "bootstrapping") AND (agent OR tool OR code) AND (RL OR iteration)
hard_exclusions: 金融技术指标 RSI（Relative Strength Index）或量化交易择时论文

topics.name: 游戏智能体
topics.focus: 游戏中的学习、推理、长程规划、自动化玩测（playtesting）、可验证任务、游戏环境与基准，不限于游戏生成。
arxiv_queries: ("game agent" OR "game-playing agent" OR "video game") AND (LLM OR VLM OR RL)
("playtesting" OR "game testing" OR "game benchmark") AND agent
("Minecraft" OR "StarCraft" OR "NetHack" OR "Pokemon" OR "Atari") AND (VLM OR LLM) AND agent
hard_exclusions: 仅研究博弈论纯数学均衡而无游戏环境/智能体实验的论文

topics.name: World Model
topics.focus: 优先 GUI / digital world model：界面、网页、文件、应用或 OS 的状态建模、转移预测、轨迹转环境、模拟训练与前瞻规划；区分像素截图预测、隐状态、结构化文本/DOM 树和真实可执行模拟。
arxiv_queries: "world model" AND (GUI OR web OR mobile OR OS OR agent OR digital)
("trajectory to world" OR "action world model" OR "interactive world model") AND (agent OR GUI OR web)
("state transition" OR "environment simulator" OR "next-state prediction") AND (GUI OR web OR computer)
hard_exclusions: 完全脱离交互与动作条件控制的纯视频生成模型（除非明确用于交互式环境模拟或动作条件状态转移）

topics.name: Personal Agent
topics.focus: 长期记忆、用户偏好建模、私有工作空间、跨应用个人执行、持续适应、主动协助（proactive assistance）与安全权限边界。区分个人助理与特定企业岗位 SOP 学习。
arxiv_queries: ("personal agent" OR "personal assistant" OR "proactive assistant") AND (LLM OR memory OR preference)
("long-term memory" OR "user preference" OR "lifelong personalization") AND agent
("personal workspace" OR "desktop assistant" OR "permission boundary") AND agent
hard_exclusions: 纯推荐系统点击率（CTR）预测且无智能体交互/记忆/执行机制的传统广告论文
